purpose: Built-in functional/thematic plans, custom plans, and report freshness design review; fictional example data

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, redesign an existing product screen.
Create ONE simple Chinese NocoBase Studio project-quality page design using the attached image ONLY as a visual-style reference. Retain the familiar sidebar, colors, type and native Studio feel, but redesign the main content to show a NEW plan-based organization. Do not retain the old dimension strip, task matrix or issue table.
Landscape approximately 1600×1100, crisp Chinese text, no device/browser frame, white sidebar, pale gray canvas, blue accents, thin gray borders, generous readable spacing. This is a proposal screenshot, not a diagram or collage.

New product concept:
Built-in test plans are grouped into three tabs:
“功能测试” contains exactly “发布测试” and “每日测试”.
“专题测试” contains extensible plans such as security, performance, permissions, UX and browser compatibility, with detailed testing methods supplied by Skills.
“自定义计划” lets a user create plans for their own requirements.
Only ONE tab's content is visible. Show 功能测试 ACTIVE. Do NOT flatten all plans or all dimensions onto one page. Do NOT add per-task automatic-trigger controls from the older proposal. Users can start a built-in plan or configure a schedule. Skills guide HOW it is tested.
Release readiness may also consider applicable thematic-test results; release functional tests alone do not stand for every release criterion.

Left sidebar as reference: NocoBase logo; 我的任务, 我的会话; 开发 group with 任务, 质量 highlighted blue, 项目, 知识库; bottom NocoBase Studio.
Main breadcrumb “质量 / Studio”.
Header title “Studio”, subtitle “负责人 杨洽”. Right quiet outline button “与 Agent 讨论” and refresh icon. Remove the old text “持续测试已开启”.
At the top of the content retain TWO SHORT evaluation cards side by side:
Left title “整体质量”, large red verdict “风险较高”, explanatory sentence “存在权限风险，部分功能仍有异常。”
Right title “发布质量”, large amber verdict “暂不建议发布”, explanatory sentence “需处理阻塞问题并补齐必要验证。”
These cards must use conclusions first, not just counts. Keep them compact.

Below the assessment cards, prominent primary tabs:
“功能测试” ACTIVE with blue underline, “专题测试”, “自定义计划”.
Do not add more tabs.
Under active tabs a concise gray description: “验证开发任务的业务功能及其对已有流程的影响。”

Then TWO stacked spacious white built-in-plan panels, occupying the rest of the page:
First panel:
Header simple release icon, bold title “发布测试”, small gray tag “内置”.
Scope description “验证当前待发布任务的功能与回归影响。”
Small scope text “当前范围：8 个待发布任务”.
Main recent conclusion label “最近结论”, red verdict “功能验证未通过”.
Reason text “发现 1 项功能异常，2 个检查点待验证。”
Bottom metadata: “最近测试  11 月 4 日 10:30” and “执行安排  按需执行”.
Actions aligned on the right: blue primary button “开始测试”; outlined button “设置定时”; small blue text link “查看报告”.
Only these actions; no new-plan button in this built-in tab.

Second panel:
Header simple calendar icon, bold title “每日测试”, small gray tag “内置”.
Scope description “每天验证前一天已完成的任务，重点检查功能与回归。”
Main recent conclusion label “最近结论”, green verdict “功能验证通过”.
Reason text “本轮验证 5 个任务，24 个检查点通过。”
Bottom metadata: “最近测试  11 月 4 日 03:00” and a small clock “每日 03:00 · 已启用”.
Actions on the right: blue primary button “开始测试”; outlined button “调整定时”; small blue text link “查看报告”.
Make the two panels visually consistent. State and reasons should be easy to read, and actions should not crowd the title.

Small bottom hint “发布判断会结合功能测试、相关专题测试和未解决问题。”
Small image footer “设计讨论稿 · 示例数据”.

Constraints: ONE screen only, ONE active tab only; no active content for 专题测试 or 自定义计划 on this screenshot, no task matrix, no extra charts, no fake aggregate score, no complex settings modal. Preserve exact tab labels 功能测试 / 专题测试 / 自定义计划. Keep page simple, polished, readable, and appropriate for a discussion of information architecture.

Use case: ui-mockup, precise screen variant. The supplied image is the approved simple plan-based NocoBase Studio Quality page. Create its “专题测试” tab variant, preserving the sidebar, breadcrumb, Studio header, overall-quality and release-quality assessment cards, fonts, spacing, and colors. Keep a landscape 1568×1003 composition and readable Chinese. Change ONLY the active tab and content below the three tabs.

Three tabs exactly “功能测试”, “专题测试” ACTIVE with blue underline, “自定义计划”.
Intro below: “内置专业测试计划，按 Skills 中的方法执行，可直接开始或设置定时。”

Replace the two function-plan cards with one white spacious table panel.
Columns “专题计划”, “最近结论”, “上次测试”, “执行安排”, “操作”.
Five rows:
1 “安全测试”, secondary “输入校验与敏感信息保护”; green conclusion “未发现风险”; time “11 月 4 日 09:00”; schedule “每周一 03:00”; actions outline-blue “开始测试” and text “定时设置”.
2 “性能测试”, secondary “响应时间与关键流程负载”; amber conclusion “需要关注”; time “11 月 4 日 08:00”; schedule “按需执行”; same actions.
3 “权限测试”, secondary “角色权限与数据访问边界”; red conclusion “风险较高”; time “11 月 4 日 09:30”; schedule “每日 03:00”; same actions.
4 “UX 测试”, secondary “操作流程与交互反馈”; amber conclusion “需要优化”; time “11 月 3 日 15:00”; schedule “按需执行”; same actions.
5 “浏览器兼容测试”, secondary “关键流程在不同浏览器中的表现”; gray conclusion “尚未测试”; time “—”; schedule “按需执行”; same actions.
Each plan name is a clickable dark-blue link to its report. A small subdued “内置” label can appear next to each title, no overly large badges. Keep enough width for plan names and the two actions, do not crowd text. Do not show self-defined plans in this active tab.
Below panel small gray hint “可通过 Skills 扩展专题计划及检查方法。”
Retain a small “设计讨论稿 · 示例数据” footer.
Preserve the top conclusions: “整体质量 / 风险较高 / 存在权限风险，部分功能仍有异常。” and “发布质量 / 暂不建议发布 / 需处理阻塞问题并补齐必要验证。” No extra scores, no new dialogs, no charts, no additional tabs.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing Chinese NocoBase Studio quality-report screenshot. Preserve its native sidebar, top navigation, real report layout and ALL existing report metrics, numerical results and scenario tree. This is a report-design illustration; keep crisp Chinese text. Do not invent a new dashboard. Add a prominent but restrained freshness strip so readers know WHEN the last completed test happened and HOW MANY new requirements are not covered by this report.

Change page title and breadcrumb final label to “供应商管理 · 发布测试”. Keep small green “已完成” badge, which describes execution completion, not test success.
Replace the old subtitle “质量判断 · 存在失败项” with “负责人 陈晓    共 1 轮测试”.
Keep the report tabs “报告 / 目标 / 后续任务 / 设置” and existing round selector with “第 1 轮 · 11月3日 03:00 · 已完成 · 当前轮次”.
Below the round-selector/action toolbar and ABOVE the quality-conclusion card, insert a clean pale-amber horizontal information strip, with three aligned areas:
Left: small label “上次测试”, prominent value “11 月 3 日 03:00”.
Middle: small label “此后新增待测需求”, prominent amber value “3 项”.
Right: blue text link “查看新增需求”.
A second short line within the strip: “本报告尚未覆盖这 3 项需求。”
This wording is important: the 3 are new in-scope requirements AFTER the report's test scope, not failed checkpoints in the historical report. Do not alter the historical report percentages or include those 3 in its totals.

Keep the existing buttons “查看报告”, “查看进展”, “再次测试”, and the original “质量结论” card and its failure badge. Preserve all figures below: 本轮检查点通过率 93.8% (45 / 48); 已有测试覆盖率 83.3% (完整 40 / 48, 部分 6, 缺失 2); 复用用例执行 186; 本计划后续任务 4; 检查点结果 通过45, 不通过2, 未验证1. Retain the original six-group scenario layout as far as fits. It is acceptable to move the original content down slightly and extend the canvas height to avoid squeezing or shrinking text. Do not crop the sidebar or top header. Add an unobtrusive bottom-right footer “设计示意 · 示例数据”.
The new freshness strip is the only significant new UI element. Keep the screenshot visually consistent and simple.

Use case: ui-mockup, refine the attached NocoBase Studio project-quality page.
Keep the same native Studio sidebar, white/light-gray surfaces, blue controls, crisp Chinese typography, Studio project header and the THREE tabs 功能测试 (active), 专题测试, 自定义计划. Add a new built-in plan named “整体质量摸底” as the FIRST plan in 功能测试, above 发布测试 and 每日测试. Redesign spacing to fit three readable plan panels; a somewhat taller landscape image, about 1568×1180, is acceptable. Do not squeeze typography. This is a simple design screenshot with fictional data, not implementation.

Purpose: a project-wide baseline assessment inventories the whole system and analyzes existing automated-test assertion coverage, then combines coverage gaps, actual available test evidence and unresolved issue severity to support the overall quality verdict. A high coverage percentage must NOT override a serious unresolved issue. Coverage means business-checkpoint automation coverage, NOT source-code line coverage or test pass rate.

Top assessment cards, side by side:
Left title “整体质量”.
Large red verdict “风险较高”.
Reason “权限风险未解除，部分业务检查点缺少自动化保障。”
Two smaller supporting facts, clearly readable:
“最近摸底覆盖率 83.3%”
“未解决问题 5 项，其中高风险 1 项”
Small bottom source text “依据：整体质量摸底及后续测试结果”.
Right title “发布质量”.
Large amber verdict “暂不建议发布”.
Reason “需处理阻塞问题并补齐必要验证。”
Keep a quiet link “查看阻塞事项”.
Do not turn 83.3% into a green overall-quality score.

Tabs stay below the summary cards:
功能测试 ACTIVE | 专题测试 | 自定义计划.
Under tabs a short description “先掌握全系统质量，再持续验证待发布与每日交付的需求。”

Three stacked white panels with subtle borders, no extra charts:

FIRST, the new panel:
Title “整体质量摸底”, gray tag “内置”.
Description “盘点全系统功能，分析自动化覆盖缺口，汇总未解决问题。”
Body has concise two-column or inline information:
“本次摸底范围：12 个模块，120 个业务检查点”
“自动化覆盖率 83.3%”
“完整覆盖 100 / 120 · 部分覆盖 12 · 缺失 8”
“未解决问题 5 项，其中高风险 1 项”
Use neutral large numeric typography for coverage; red only for serious risk.
Bottom metadata “上次摸底 11 月 4 日 09:00”.
Also a clearly visible amber small note “此后新增 3 项需求，待纳入摸底”. This makes clear that the 83.3% refers to the last baseline, not new requirements which were never analyzed.
Right-aligned controls “开始测试” blue primary button, “设置定时” outlined button, “查看摸底报告” text link.
Keep the new panel visually integrated with the other built-in plans, not a separate fourth tab.

SECOND:
Title “发布测试”, gray tag “内置”.
Description “验证当前待发布任务的功能与回归影响。”
Scope “当前范围：8 个待发布任务”.
Recent conclusion red “功能验证未通过”, support “1 项功能异常，2 个检查点待验证”.
Metadata “上次测试 11 月 4 日 10:30 · 按需执行”.
Right controls “开始测试”, “设置定时”, “查看报告”.

THIRD:
Title “每日测试”, gray tag “内置”.
Description “每天验证前一天已完成的任务，重点检查功能与回归。”
Recent conclusion green “功能验证通过”, support “本轮验证 5 个任务，24 个检查点通过”.
Metadata “上次测试 11 月 4 日 03:00 · 每日 03:00 已启用”.
Right controls “开始测试”, “调整定时”, “查看报告”.

Make ALL three panels visible in one image. It is acceptable to reduce unnecessary empty margins or extend height moderately. Avoid huge decorative icons. Keep action columns aligned. Footer “设计讨论稿 · 示例数据”.
Do not add arbitrary scoring thresholds, claim 83.3% equals good quality, or pretend only one passing test establishes project quality. Keep the interface simple and readable.
